ai_content:
Here is a comprehensive design for a **Social Media Content Manager** Notion template. This system is built for solo creators, social media managers, and small marketing teams. It focuses on the entire lifecycle of a post: **Idea → Draft → Approval → Schedule → Publish → Analyze.**

---

## 🧱 1. Core Database Structure

The template uses a single, powerful master database called **"Content Hub"** with linked **"Assets"** and **"Analytics"** databases for granular tracking.

### **Database A: Content Hub (Master)**
This is your primary workspace. Every row = one piece of content (post, story, video, carousel).

### **Database B: Content Assets (Linked)**
A gallery database for raw files, images, copy drafts, and links. Each asset is linked to a specific piece of content.

### **Database C: Analytics (Rollup)**
A read-only database that aggregates performance data from external tools (or manual input) per post.

---

## 📊 2. Properties (Columns) for the "Content Hub"

| Property Name | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Title** | Title (Plain Text) | The main headline or caption idea. (e.g., "5 Tips for Productivity") |
| **Status** | Select | `Idea` → `Drafting` → `Review` → `Approved` → `Scheduled` → `Published` → `Archived` |
| **Platform** | Multi-Select | `Instagram`, `TikTok`, `LinkedIn`, `Twitter/X`, `YouTube`, `Facebook`, `Pinterest` |
| **Content Type** | Select | `Carousel`, `Reel`, `Static Image`, `Text Post`, `Thread`, `Video`, `Story` |
| **Theme / Campaign** | Select | `Brand Awareness`, `Product Launch`, `Educational`, `User Generated`, `Holiday`, `Behind the Scenes` |
| **Publish Date** | Date | The exact date and time the post goes live. |
| **Time Zone** | Select | `EST`, `PST`, `GMT`, etc. |
| **Copy/Text** | Text | Full caption, script, or tweet text. |
| **Hashtags** | Multi-Select | Core and trending hashtags (e.g., `#productivity`, `#tips`). |
| **Asset Link** | Relation | Links to the **Content Assets** database (images, videos, drafts). |
| **Approval Status** | Status | `Pending` → `In Review` → `Approved` → `Changes Requested` |
| **Post URL** | URL | The live link after publishing. |
| **Cost (USD)** | Number | Ad spend, designer fee, or stock photo cost. |
| **Created Date** | Created Time | Auto-generated. |
| **Last Edited** | Last Edited Time | Auto-generated. |

---

## 🎯 3. Formulas (Calculated Properties)

These formulas add intelligence and save you manual work.

### **Formula 1: "Days Until Publish"**
*Shows a countdown. Red if overdue, green if on track.*
```notion
if(empty(prop("Publish Date")), "", 
  format(dateBetween(prop("Publish Date"), now(), "days")) + " days")
```

### **Formula 2: "Full Caption Preview"**
*Concatenates text and hashtags into a ready-to-copy string.*
```notion
prop("Copy/Text") + "\n\n" + 
  if(empty(prop("Hashtags")), "", 
    replaceAll(prop("Hashtags"), ",", " ") + "\n\n" + 
    "---" + "\n" + 
    "📸 " + prop("Content Type") + " | " + prop("Platform")
  )
```
*Output example: "5 Tips for Productivity\n\n#productivity #tips #work\n---\n📸 Carousel | LinkedIn"*

### **Formula 3: "Status Color Code"**
*Assigns an emoji icon for quick visual scanning.*
```notion
if(prop("Status") == "Idea", "💡", 
  if(prop("Status") == "Drafting", "✏️", 
    if(prop("Status") == "Review", "👀", 
      if(prop("Status") == "Approved", "✅", 
        if(prop("Status") == "Scheduled", "📅", 
          if(prop("Status") == "Published", "🚀", 
            if(prop("Status") == "Archived", "🗄️", "❓")
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
```

---

## 👁️ 4. Views (How You See the Data)

You will create **5 distinct views** in the database, each with a specific filter and sort.

### **View 1: "📋 Content Calendar" (Board View)**
- **Group by:** `Status`
- **Sort by:** `Publish Date` (ascending)
- **Layout:** Columns: `Idea` | `Drafting` | `Review` | `Approved` | `Scheduled` | `Published` | `Archived`
- **Card Preview:** Show `Title`, `Platform`, `Publish Date`, `Status Color Code` (Formula 3).
- **Function:** Drag and drop posts between stages. Instantly see your pipeline.

### **View 2: "📅 Monthly Calendar" (Calendar View)**
- **Group by:** `Publish Date`
- **Filter:** `Status` is not `Archived`
- **Layout:** Day-by-day calendar. Each block shows `Title` and `Platform`.
- **Function:** See your publishing rhythm. Spot gaps or over-posting days.

### **View 3: "📝 Content Library" (Table View)**
- **Filter:** `Status` is not `Archived`
- **Sort by:** `Created Date` (descending)
- **Properties shown:** All properties (Title, Status, Platform, Type, Theme, Publish Date, Copy, Hashtags, Post URL).
- **Function:** Full data view. Use for bulk editing, filtering by platform, or exporting.

### **View 4: "📊 Analytics Dashboard" (Gallery View)**
- **Filter:** `Status` is `Published` AND `Post URL` is not empty
- **Sort by:** `Publish Date` (descending)
- **Card Preview:** Show `Title`, `Platform`, `Post URL`, and a manual `Engagement Score` property (Number, added manually or via API).
- **Function:** Visual gallery of published work. Click to open live post. Track performance.
